note: Bridger-Teton NF campground on a small point on the south shore of Willow Lake, about 11 miles north of Pinedale on Willow Lake Road (the last stretch dirt), with Wind River Range views. Bear boxes at every site. A boat launch with a dock and a second toilet is just west. Lake levels rise in spring. No livestock. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov read: FCFS, $10 (rec.gov; FS shows $12 and 'No Fee'), 14-day, vault toilets, no water, no hookups (manual).
